C0209.title: Jiangxi Man Sentenced for Building Fake Order Platform, Earning 7.8 Million Yuan
C0209.summary: Between June 2020 and January 2024, a man surnamed Chen from Xiushui County, Jiangxi Province, created a fake order platform called 'Taoyuanzhijia' and recruited people to place fraudulent orders for online stores.
